events.title: Unix development begins at Bell Labs
events.titleZh: Unix 在贝尔实验室开始开发
events.summary: Unix began as a compact, multiuser operating system project whose design culture shaped later software, networking, servers, and open systems.
events.summaryZh: Unix 最初是一个紧凑的多用户操作系统项目，它的设计文化后来深刻影响软件、网络、服务器和开放系统。
sourceNotes: Unix's Bell Labs origins are standard in operating systems histories.
events.eventIntro: Unix development began at Bell Labs in 1969 as a smaller, more flexible response to large time-sharing systems. It favored simple tools, files as interfaces, and a programming environment built for developers.
events.eventIntroZh: Unix 于 1969 年在贝尔实验室开始开发，是对大型分时系统的一种更小、更灵活的回应。它偏好简单工具、以文件作为接口，以及面向开发者的编程环境。
events.whyMatters: Unix became less important as a single product than as a software lineage. Its ideas shaped BSD, Linux, macOS, servers, internet infrastructure, shell culture, and the way programmers think about composable tools.
events.whyMattersZh: Unix 作为单一产品的重要性不如作为软件谱系的重要性。它的理念影响 BSD、Linux、macOS、服务器、互联网基础设施、shell 文化，以及程序员对可组合工具的理解。
events.phaseRelation: This event anchors the Unix, C, and portable software phase because Unix made operating systems feel like portable programming environments rather than machine-specific control software.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它锚定了“Unix、C 与可移植软件”阶段，因为 Unix 让操作系统更像可移植的编程环境，而不只是特定机器的控制软件。
events.connectionHint: Unix connects naturally to networks and open source: many later internet servers, protocols, and developer workflows grew from Unix-like environments.
events.connectionHintZh: Unix 自然连接到网络和开源：许多后来的互联网服务器、协议和开发者工作流都生长于类 Unix 环境。

events.title: Linux kernel announced
events.summary: Linus Torvalds announced the Linux kernel, helping turn Unix-like software into a global open-source infrastructure layer.
events.summaryZh: 林纳斯·托瓦兹发布 Linux 内核，推动类 Unix 软件成为全球开源基础设施层。
sourceNotes: Linux is a central open-source operating-system milestone.
events.eventIntro: In 1991, Linus Torvalds announced an early version of a free Unix-like kernel. Combined with GNU tools and internet collaboration, Linux became a practical open operating system.
events.eventIntroZh: 1991 年，林纳斯·托瓦兹发布了一个自由的类 Unix 内核早期版本。结合 GNU 工具和互联网协作，Linux 成为实用的开放操作系统。
events.whyMatters: Linux helped move open-source software from ideology and hobbyist practice into servers, embedded devices, cloud infrastructure, Android, and supercomputing.
events.whyMattersZh: Linux 帮助开源软件从理念和爱好者实践进入服务器、嵌入式设备、云基础设施、Android 和超级计算。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to the Open source and web software phase because it shows how internet collaboration and open licensing could produce infrastructure-grade software.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“开源与 Web 软件”阶段，因为它显示互联网协作和开放许可可以生产基础设施级软件。
events.connectionHint: It connects operating systems to cloud computing and cybersecurity, since Linux became a common substrate for servers, containers, permissions, and security tooling.
events.connectionHintZh: 它把操作系统连接到云计算和网络安全，因为 Linux 成为服务器、容器、权限和安全工具的常见底层。

events.title: Docker released
events.summary: Docker popularized containerized application packaging and helped change how software moved from development to production.
events.summaryZh: Docker 推广了容器化应用打包，并改变了软件从开发到生产环境的迁移方式。
sourceNotes: Docker is a core milestone in container and DevOps histories.
events.eventIntro: Docker was released in 2013 and made Linux containers approachable for developers. It packaged applications with dependencies into portable images that could run consistently across environments.
events.eventIntroZh: Docker 于 2013 年发布，让 Linux 容器对开发者变得易用。它把应用和依赖打包成可移植镜像，使其能在不同环境中一致运行。
events.whyMatters: Docker changed the practical boundary between development, operations, and infrastructure. It made container workflows common in startups, enterprises, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms.
events.whyMattersZh: Docker 改变了开发、运维和基础设施之间的实践边界。它让容器工作流在初创公司、企业、CI/CD 流水线和云平台中普及。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to the DevOps, containers, and platform engineering phase because it turned containerization into a standard software delivery pattern.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“DevOps、容器与平台工程”阶段，因为它把容器化变成标准的软件交付模式。
events.connectionHint: Docker connects to Kubernetes, cloud platforms, supply-chain security, and the rise of platform engineering teams.
events.connectionHintZh: Docker 连接到 Kubernetes、云平台、供应链安全，以及平台工程团队的兴起。

events.title: Kubernetes announced
events.summary: Kubernetes made container orchestration a shared industry layer for deploying, scaling, and operating cloud-native services.
events.summaryZh: Kubernetes 让容器编排成为部署、扩展和运行云原生服务的共同产业层。
sourceNotes: Kubernetes is a standard milestone in cloud-native infrastructure history.
events.eventIntro: Google announced Kubernetes in 2014 as an open-source system for orchestrating containers. It gave teams a common way to schedule workloads, manage services, and automate deployment across clusters.
events.eventIntroZh: Google 于 2014 年发布 Kubernetes，这是一个用于编排容器的开源系统。它为团队提供了在集群中调度工作负载、管理服务和自动化部署的共同方式。
events.whyMatters: Kubernetes became a platform for platforms. It changed infrastructure from individual servers into declarative clusters managed through APIs, controllers, and ecosystem tooling.
events.whyMattersZh: Kubernetes 成为“平台的平台”。它把基础设施从单台服务器转变为通过 API、控制器和生态工具管理的声明式集群。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to the DevOps, containers, and platform engineering phase because it made container operations a reusable infrastructure abstraction.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“DevOps、容器与平台工程”阶段，因为它把容器运维变成可复用的基础设施抽象。
events.connectionHint: It connects software engineering to cloud economics, reliability engineering, security policy, and the professionalization of platform teams.
events.connectionHintZh: 它把软件工程连接到云经济、可靠性工程、安全策略和平台团队的专业化。
